exercises.instruction: Choose the correct future perfect continuous form.
exercises.prompt: By the end of this year, I ___ English for five years.
exercises.hint: 'By the end of this year' + duration emphasis → future perfect continuous.
exercises.explanation: Duration of ongoing activity up to a future point → will have been + Ving.

exercises.instruction: Choose the form that emphasises duration of effort.
exercises.prompt: By the time she crosses the finish line, she ___ for over three hours.
exercises.hint: 'Over three hours' of continuous activity before a future point → future perfect continuous.
exercises.explanation: Duration of ongoing activity before a future point → will have been + Ving.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct negative future perfect continuous.
exercises.prompt: By next month, she ___ properly for several weeks — the stress is taking its toll.
exercises.hint: Ongoing pattern leading to a future point, negative → won't have been + Ving.
exercises.explanation: Negative ongoing activity up to a future point → won't have been + Ving.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct 'How long' future perfect continuous question.
exercises.prompt: How long ___ you ___ this company when you retire?
exercises.hint: 'How long' + duration up to a future point → will have been + Ving.
exercises.explanation: Duration question to a future point: How long + will + subject + have been + Ving.

exercises.instruction: Stative or action verb? Choose the right form.
exercises.prompt: By our wedding anniversary, we ___ each other for ten years.
exercises.hint: 'Know' is stative — cannot use continuous. Duration to a future point + stative = future perfect simple.
exercises.explanation: Stative verb → future perfect simple: will have known (not will have been knowing).

exercises.instruction: Completion vs duration — which tense fits?
exercises.prompt: By 5pm, he ___ the entire proposal. You can read it then.
exercises.hint: 'You can read it then' = it's finished → focus on completion → future perfect simple.
exercises.explanation: Completed result → future perfect simple. Continuous would imply still in progress.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct answer for: the future perfect continuous form.
exercises.prompt: By the time this project ends, the team ___ (work) on it for two years.
exercises.explanation: 'By the time' + duration → will have been + Ving.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct answer for: the negative. Both 'won't have been' and 'will not have been' accepted.
exercises.prompt: By next year, she ___ (not / teach) long enough to apply for promotion.
exercises.explanation: Negative future perfect continuous: won't have been / will not have been + Ving.

exercises.instruction: Form the 'How long' future perfect continuous question.
exercises.prompt: How long ___ (she / study) medicine by the time she qualifies as a doctor?
exercises.hint: How long + will + subject + have been + Ving.
exercises.explanation: Duration question to a future point: How long + will she have been + Ving.

exercises.instruction: Translate into English: "Pada bulan Desember, saya sudah belajar bahasa Inggris selama 5 tahun."
exercises.prompt: Pada bulan Desember, saya sudah belajar bahasa Inggris selama 5 tahun.
options: By December, I will have been studying English for five years.
By December, I will has been studying English for five years.
By December, I will had been studying English for five years.
By December, I will have been studying English for five is yearing.
exercises.answer: By December, I will have been studying English for five years.
exercises.explanation: Duration of ongoing activity to a future deadline → will have been + Ving.

exercises.instruction: Translate into English: "Saat proyek ini selesai, tim kami sudah bekerja keras selama dua tahun."
exercises.prompt: Saat proyek ini selesai, tim kami sudah bekerja keras selama dua tahun.
options: By the time this project is done, our team will have been working hard for two years.
By a time this project is done, our team will have been working hard for two years.
By the time this project was done, our team will had been working hard for two years.
By the time this project is done, our team will has been working hard for two years.
exercises.answer: By the time this project is done, our team will have been working hard for two years.
exercises.explanation: Duration of ongoing effort up to a future point → will have been + Ving.

exercises.instruction: Translate into English: "Pada ulang tahun pernikahan kami yang ke-10, kami sudah saling mengenal selama 15 tahun."
exercises.prompt: Pada ulang tahun pernikahan kami yang ke-10, kami sudah saling mengenal selama 15 tahun.
options: By our 10th wedding anniversary, we will have known each other for 15 years.
By our 10th wedding anniversary, we will have known each other for 15 is yearing.
By our 10th wedding anniversary, we will has known each other for 15 years.
By our 10th wedding anniversary, we will known each other for 15 years.
exercises.answer: By our 10th wedding anniversary, we will have known each other for 15 years.
exercises.explanation: 'Know' is stative — cannot use continuous form. Future perfect simple: will have known.
